“He is the kind of personality, the kind of coach, who makes our footballing world a better place. He has charisma and is an incredible communicator”.

“I'm very happy that he has returned to coaching. Football needs personalities like Jürgen. I believe that under his leadership, Germany will manage to get back on track, that the team will be viewed differently again, that the joy will return and that the fans will once again be proud of their team. When I heard that he was going to become your new Germany head coach, I was delighted”.

“Jürgen will inspire the players to embrace his style of football, and things will get better again. Whether they win the next Euros or the World Cup, nobody can say.
